subject: Retention incentive endorsement request — GreenTree Health
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa@greentreehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Retention incentive endorsement request — GreenTree Health

Alyssa — thanks again for the conversation earlier. GreenTree is aligned to a 24-month commitment but has pushed back on the up-front ramp cost for Q1. They asked whether we can structure a one-time "retention incentive" credit at contract signature plus a deferred billing schedule for the first 90 days.

Attachments: GreenTree_Retention_Counter_v1.pdf (customer counter-proposal)

High level ask from GreenTree:
- One-time retention credit applied to first invoice (they propose 18% of year-1 committed spend)
- Option to split invoice 60/40 across first two invoices (deferred 40% to month 2)
- Signature within 10 business days in exchange for an expanded usage SLA window

My recommended commercial compromise: 15% one-time retention credit (applied at invoice #1) + 45/55 invoice split to preserve cash flow. We should also require DocuSign routing and milestone clause for usage-based true-up at month 3.

Ben / Marissa — tagging you for internal approval and any immediate concerns (pricing thresholds, accounting treatment). If this needs VP/CFO signoff, please advise and I'll assemble the memo.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

From: Alyssa Park <alyssa@greentreehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Retention incentive endorsement request — GreenTree Health

Thanks Logan — appreciate the quick read. We put together a short counter to make things concrete (attached). Our finance lead prefers the larger one-time credit to offset our initial onboarding risk; 18% would get us comfortable and expedite exec approval on our side.

Key items for us:
- 18% credit applied to first invoice; invoicing split 60/40 acceptable
- Net-45 payment terms on the deferred portion (month 2 invoice)
- Implementation milestones tied to credit release (we need the onboarding window guarantees)

If Redwood can sign off by next Friday, we can commit to the 24-month term and increase initial usage commitment by ~20% year-1.

Attachment: GreenTree_Retention_Counter_v1.pdf

Best,
Alyssa Park
Head of Strategic Partnerships | GreenTree Health
alyssa@greentreehealth.com

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Retention incentive endorsement request — GreenTree Health

Ben / Marissa / Vanessa — forwarding GreenTree's counter (attached). I captured the ask above and recommend the following pragmatic path so we don't lose momentum:

Proposed Redwood response (recommended):
- One-time retention incentive credit = 15% of year-1 committed ARR, applied to invoice #1
- Invoice schedule: 55% invoice #1, 45% invoice #2 (deferred 30 days); deferred portion to Net-45
- Implementation milestone: credit is contingent on reaching onboarding milestone A (configuration complete) within 60 days; otherwise credit reduces to 7.5%
- DocuSign + HubSpot deal task to track the milestone and true-up

Why this helps: keeps our upfront cash exposure lower than their ask, preserves momentum, and ties credit to measurable milestones.

Numbers at a glance (rounded):
- Year-1 committed ARR: $1,200,000
- 18% of ARR = $216,000 (GreenTree ask)
- 15% of ARR = $180,000 (our recommend)

If internal signoff required (>15% or credits >$150k trigger escalation per policy), please confirm who to send the memo to — I've drafted a short memo (retention_memo_for_vp.docx) and can route to finance/cfo.

Attachments: proposal_v2.pdf (redlined commercial response)

Logan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Retention incentive endorsement request — GreenTree Health

Thanks for the clear summary Logan. A few notes from finance & revenue ops:

1) Policy: any one-time credit greater than 15% of contracted year-1 ARR OR any absolute credit > $150k requires VP/CFO approval and a short exec memo outlining rationale, margin impact, and accounting treatment.

2) The numbers you sent put the recommended credit at $180k (15%) — this is right at the threshold for escalation (because rounding and potential discounts on add-ons could push effective credit >$150k). We should submit a concise memo for Markus's review.

3) Accounting impact: if we apply a credit at invoice #1 with deferred invoicing, revenue recognition rules mean we need the milestone clause explicitly documented. Please include language that ties credit release to onboarding milestone A (config + API contract test) and the true-up mechanics at month 3.

I attached a draft memo template (retention_memo_for_vp.docx) with the commercial rationale, competitive context, and suggested approval language. Logan — can you fill in the short customer-facing justification and final numbers, then I'll route to Markus for signoff? Also confirm whether marketing credits or professional services discounts are being layered in (we need to avoid double-counting).

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: retention_memo_for_vp.docx

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 17:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Retention incentive endorsement request — GreenTree Health

Reviewed the memo and the numbers. Approval provided with the following binding conditions:

1) Approve a one-time retention incentive credit equal to 15% of year-1 committed ARR (total credit = $180,000) applied to invoice #1.
2) Invoice schedule must be 55% / 45% with Net-45 on the deferred portion.
3) Credit is contingent on meeting onboarding milestone A within 60 days; if milestone not met, credit reduces to 7.5% automatically.
4) Legal to include an explicit clause for the month-3 usage true-up and for clawback language in the event of material breach in the first 6 months.
5) Sales to confirm no additional PS/marketing discounts are layered on top (any additional concessions must be re-escalated).

Please proceed and get DocuSign routed. Logan — close the loop with GreenTree and attach the signed memo to the HubSpot deal.

-Markus Klein
Interim CFO | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

(Header: This email serves as documented VP/CFO signoff for the internal record.)
